question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(r.runs_conceded, 0) as runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN bw.wickets_taken > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(r.runs_conceded, 0) / bw.wickets_taken ELSE NULL END as bowling_average
FROM bowler_wickets bw
LEFT JOIN bowler_runs r ON bw.bowler = r.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1
